answer: Photocopied credentials let one lab enroll many voting keys. This intake assigns each applicant one coastal island berth and a unique opal diffraction wafer, imaged only inside a posted zenith window. Three unaffiliated wardens, 97 minutes apart, each confirm a live spectrogram and post hue_i = blake2s(addr||wafer_id||spectra_root||warden_pk||i). Imaging costs 0.36 POA; 17 POA locks for nine epochs. Peers replay the public plate log, recompute every hue_i, and check berth uniqueness. A shared berth, reused wafer, or off-window shot forfeits the bond and grounds both keys for sixteen epochs.
